snp1.12:1.2: a home gives birth to dust.
snp1.12:1.3:
Free from a home,
free from intimacy:
snp1.12:1.4: Such is the vision of the sage.
snp1.12:2.1:
Who, destroying what’s born,
wouldn’t plant (again)
snp1.12:2.3: They call him the wandering, solitary sage.
snp1.12:2.4:
He, the great seer
has seen
the state of peace.
snp1.12:3.1:
Considering the ground,
crushing the seed,
snp1.12:3.3:
—truly a sage—
seer of the ending of birth,
snp1.12:3.4:
abandoning conjecture,
he cannot be classified.
snp1.12:4.2: not longing for any one anywhere
snp1.12:4.3:
—truly a sage—
with no coveting, without greed,
snp1.12:4.4:
he does not build,
for he has gone beyond.
snp1.12:5.2:
With regard to all things:
unsmeared.
snp1.12:5.3:
Abandoning all,
in the ending of craving,
released:
snp1.12:5.4: The enlightened call him a sage.
snp1.12:6.1:
With discernment his strength,
well-endowed in habit & practice,
snp1.12:6.4: The enlightened call him a sage.
snp1.12:7.3: unstartled, like a lion at sounds,
snp1.12:7.4: uncaught, like the wind in a net,
snp1.12:7.5: unsmeared, like a lotus in water,
snp1.12:7.6: leader of others, by others unled:
snp1.12:7.7: The enlightened call him a sage.
snp1.12:8.1:
Who becomes
like the pillar at a bathing ford,
snp1.12:8.3:
he, without passion,
his senses well-centered:
snp1.12:8.4: The enlightened call him a sage.
snp1.12:9.1: Truly poised, straight as a shuttle,
snp1.12:9.4: The enlightened call him a sage.
snp1.12:10.1: Restrained in mind, he does no evil.
snp1.12:10.4: The enlightened call him a sage.
snp1.12:11.1:
From the best
the middling
the leftovers
he receives alms.
Sustaining himself on what others give,
snp1.12:11.4: The enlightened call him a sage.
snp1.12:12.1:
The wandering sage
abstaining from sex,
snp1.12:12.2: in youth bound by no one,
snp1.12:12.3:
abstaining from intoxication
complacency,
totally apart:
snp1.12:12.4: The enlightened call him a sage.
snp1.12:13.1:
Knowing the world,
seeing the highest goal,
snp1.12:13.3:
his chains broken,
unattached,
without effluent:
snp1.12:13.4: The enlightened call him a sage.
snp1.12:14.1:
These two are different,
they dwell far apart:
snp1.12:14.2:
the householder supporting a wife
and the unselfish one, of good practices.
snp1.12:14.3:
Slaying other beings, the householder
is unrestrained.
snp1.12:14.4:
Constantly the sage protects other beings,
is controlled.
snp1.12:15.1:
Just as the crested,
blue-necked peacock,
when flying,
snp1.12:15.2:
never matches
the wild goose
in speed,
snp1.12:15.3:
even so the householder
never keeps up with the monk—
snp1.12:15.4:
the sage secluded
in the forest,
doing jhāna.
